info.name: SwaggerHub Registry APIs API
info.description:
The SwaggerHub Registry API provides programmatic access to all SwaggerHub resources: APIs, domains, integrations, projects, templates, and standardization rulesets. Use it to manage API versions, publish APIs, run CI/CD integrations, manage projects, and retrieve OpenAPI definitions.

Contact Support:
 Name: SmartBear SwaggerHub Support
